answer: Three leasing companies give the lease equity to the customer: Summit Auto Lease, Crescent Motor Credit and Apex Lease Co. Lease equity is the amount by which our offer is higher than the lease buyout. Bluewater Leasing doesn't pay it out. It applies the equity to the car the customer buys from Northwind. Harbor Leasing and Ironwood Lease don't allow third-party buyouts at all. Two points from the buyout rules: Crescent has only allowed third-party buyouts since February 1, 2026, and since that date Apex adds a $350 third-party buyout fee to the buyout amount.
